model.admission: Caster plus an explicitly enumerated finite set of willing, conscious, living physical companion actors perceived within120ft/LoE; no fixed party cap. Each must possess an original body and be able to give consent. NEW exclusions: already-projected actors, dead remains, unconscious actors, summoned transient bodies and wholly incorporeal actors are not eligible in this model. This is a spell-local eligibility choice, not a global creature rule.
model.siteAuthority: A destination Astral site must supply an explicit projection-admission permission, safe arrival cells, physical/environment rules and movement map. This package supplies TEST-ASTRAL-DD11 only, never a canonical planar route. Native planar access and actual cosmology remain qualified. No onward gate/teleport permission is inferred.

identity.actor: one stable actor ID, one current/maxHP/Wounds/death, RP, inventory, charges, Action/BonusAction/Reaction, movement, concentration, class history and rest ledger
identity.bodies: original physical body remains at its actual location; a spell-owned projection expression appears at the declared Astral arrival cell; it has the same shape/anatomy and ordinary senses, not a second actor
identity.control: only projection is voluntarily controlled; original body is dormant but physically vulnerable, needs continue, no free rest or healing
identity.damage: damage at either body settles on the single actor ledger. For a single damage-root that legally reaches both, apply the greatest eligible post-defense loss once (ties by stable bodyID), not twice; distinct independent roots remain distinct. This is a NEW anti-duplication interaction rule.
identity.zero: ordinary zeroHP state and callbacks still apply; immediately terminate that actor's projection and return control to its original body before its next action, without healing/stabilization or erased pending death saves
identity.death: death/destruction at either locus resolves once on the actor and original remains; projection vanishes with no second corpse/soul; no rescue from a valid Hunt or other terminal source

gear.original: real worn/carried gear remains physically with the original body and retains original ownership/custody
gear.proxy: one nonlootable source-owned use proxy per actual equipped item at projection; exact current authoritative item state is checked before every use. A stolen, destroyed, expended or unequipped original instantly invalidates its proxy
gear.costs: ammo/charges/consumables spent through a proxy debit the original item once at use commitment; no duplicate source trigger or retrievable proxy ammunition
gear.components: a still-valid legal focus proxy can supply F as this new projection permission; original V/S ability is expressed by projection, with ordinary hands/components requirements; silence or incapacitation at the actual casting locus still matters
gear.newAstralItems: genuine items picked up in Astral have their own physical custody, mass and support. They are not proxied into the original plane. On individual return put down/drop them at their exact Astral position, settle support/fall, and retain owners. No unapproved cross-plane import.

model.movementAndActions: Projection walks using the actor's actual current speed and supported body paths; no inherent flight, phasing or unrestricted navigation. It can manipulate supported Astral objects, fight or legally cast using the one actor budget. Original body cannot act simultaneously. A message to another plane needs its own actual source.

lifecycle.printedInstantaneous: initiation of new finite projection expressions
lifecycle.deadline: successful resolution+3600000ms for all original participants; no reset on save/load
lifecycle.individualReturn: participant spends one actual Action to end only its own expression; control returns to original body wherever that body actually is. No movement of original body, freeing restraints, healing, duplicated inventory or return-to-old-coordinate fiction
lifecycle.cohort: other participants keep original deadline and can act even if caster returns or dies; no second cast/deadline created
lifecycle.suppression: if an accepted provider covers a participant's relevant projection expression or source anchor, safely terminate that individual projection; return is terminal, never suspended-and-revived. Provider scope and geometry must be real
lifecycle.dispel: eligible rank9 ending terminates affected expression(s) exactly once, not unrelated cohort
lifecycle.recast: known already-projected actor is rejected at admission; a later new cast after actual return costs full resources and creates new source
lifecycle.lostOriginal: stable body location/identity is authoritative. Moving/confined original receives control in place. If destroyed, settle actual death/terminal source. Missing data is an error, not permission to fabricate a safe body/site
lifecycle.cargoEnding: genuine Astral items remain at supported Astral exit coordinates or undergo ordinary fall; projections/proxies end without loot

fixture.environment: air breathable, ordinary gravity, no hazards in listed cells, ordinary sight/hearing; explicitly synthetic

usefulObject.operation: Action opens a supported5ft-wide gate; physical mechanism and ownership permission explicitly granted by TEST-SITE-OWNER
